full_name: Jeff Gelles | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Medicine Helen Putnam Fellow Brandeis University
bio: Jeff Gelles is the Aron and Imre Tauber Professor of Biochemistry and Molecular Pharmacology in the Biochemistry Department at Brandeis University. He studies little engines, the nanometer-sized machines made of protein, RNA, and DNA molecules that carry out essential processes in living cells.
